## ⚡ Improved

- **A warning when a Personal space goes missing.** If the folder of a personal space loses the attributes OpenCloud keeps on it, for example because another folder was copied over it, OpenCloud drops the space from the web UI without an error and does not rebuild it (#31). The container now checks these folders at startup and names any broken one in the log.
- README: a new troubleshooting entry shows how to copy existing files straight into the Data folder without breaking anything, tested with OpenCloud 8.0.1 on Unraid 7.3.2, and how to get **Personal** back once it is gone.
- Updated build dependencies: bbolt 1.5.0 for the search index check, and newer vite, vitest and pnpm for the branding app.
